change: Increase BGP hold timers on all VPN hubs to 90 seconds
Add an export filter on vpn-hub-west (ASN 65303) so the retail-east prefix 172.16.10.0/24 learned from Azure transit is not advertised to peer vpn-hub-north (ASN 65304)
Add an export filter on vpn-hub-east (ASN 65302) so the finance-north prefix 172.16.30.0/24 learned from peer vpn-hub-west is not re-advertised to Azure transit ASN 65301
Restart the VPN BGP sessions on all three hubs during the next maintenance window
Enable Virtual WAN routing intent so branch prefixes stay on Azure transit and are not re-exported over hub peer shortcuts
Deploy matched export policies on vpn-hub-east (ASN 65302) and vpn-hub-west (ASN 65303) so the finance-north prefix 172.16.30.0/24 stays off both peer shortcuts and Azure transit reflections
Add an export filter on vpn-hub-north (ASN 65304) so the clinic-east prefix 172.16.40.0/24 learned from Azure transit is not advertised to peer vpn-hub-west (ASN 65303)
Disable hub peering between vpn-hub-west and vpn-hub-north
Disable branch-to-branch traffic in the Virtual WAN policy so leaked branch routes can no longer propagate between hubs
